ch2-p135.text: Freedom exists for the sake of love.
ch2-p135.notes: Karol Wojtyla, Love and Responsibility, tr. H. T. Willetts (1981), ch. II 'The Person and Love', p. 135. Next sentence: 'If freedom is not used, is not taken advantage of by love it becomes a negative thing...' Used in Ch. 4 line 71 and Ch. 11.
